implemented_scope: Structured food availability, offering, receipt, ingestion, portion and record-continuity facts only.
interpretation: This is an objective feeding-input ledger and an uninstantiated scientific framework. It does not estimate internal energy state, homeostatic drive, reward, appetite, satiety or subjective hunger.

scientific_basis.title: Homeostatic reinforcement learning for integrating reward collection and physiological stability
scientific_basis.use: Defines the general internal-state, homeostatic-drive and drive-reduction-reward framework. Its free parameters and organism-specific dynamics are deliberately not instantiated for Cy.

scientific_basis.title: Hormone and glucose signalling in POMC and AgRP neurons
scientific_basis.use: Documents integration of peripheral hormones, nutrients and opposing melanocortin-system populations; it does not supply a Cy activation equation.

scientific_basis.title: Arcuate AgRP neurons and the regulation of energy balance
scientific_basis.use: Supports treating arcuate AgRP and POMC circuitry as a complex future dependency rather than an elapsed-time proxy.

continuity: Runner downtime is retained as an explicit unknown interval. No assumption of feeding, normal meals or fasting is made across it.
limitations: Food availability and intake are not internal physiological state.
Elapsed time since known intake is factual time, not hunger, fasting certainty or homeostatic drive.
Unknown or categorical portions are not converted to fractions, calories or nutrients.
Gastrointestinal satiation, endocrine and metabolic signals, learned meal timing, sensory food cues, hedonic reward, social context and feeding action selection are not modelled.
No AgRP, NPY, POMC, leptin, ghrelin, glucose, gut-hormone or hypothalamic activity is inferred.

engineering_constants.name: public_recent_meal_records
engineering_constants.classification: DISPLAY only; the complete ledger remains persisted
